text:
nina: Heads-up team: Exec town tomorrow includes a 5-min mention of the launch. Need a single-slide summary + one-line CEO soundbite. Drop drafts here by 4pm PT.

alex: Slide deck note: we'll pull the blog hero asset and a single benchmark highlight. Which number should we show?

cameron: Use the conservative stat: "up to 2.8x throughput on long-context workloads" and footnote as provisional.

sophie: PR ask: please avoid the phrase "we're the fastest" on the slide. Use "industry-grade performance" is fine per legal.

legal: Correct: swap absolutes. Approved phrasing: "production-grade inference with predictable latency and cost controls." Also confirm any customer logos before town.

nina: Noted. CEO one-liner suggestions? Need punchy, 12 words max.

alex: Draft: "We built Redwood Inference so teams can ship LLM features with confidence."

cameron: Short variant: "Making reliable LLM inference practical for every engineering team."

sophie: Social-ready line for exec tweet (single sentence): "Excited to share Redwood Inference 1 production-grade inference for product teams. <link> #mlinfra"

legal: Please remove the emoji from the tweet if it will be used in partner comms. Emojis are ok on personal handles.

nina: OK will prepare two versions: exec tweet + internal town slide. Also: privacy policy update required for partner press kits (small copy tweak) per legal. We'll need the updated blurb in the kit.

cameron: I'll add the privacy blurb. Draft: "Redwood Inference processes inference requests without storing customer prompt contents; customers can enable customer-managed KMS for key control."

legal: Minor edit: "does not retain customer prompt contents beyond short-term caches used for inference; customers may enable customer-managed KMS integrations."

sophie: Great, I'll swap that into the press kit. PR checklist: hero image, bench one-pager, privacy blurb, CEO quote, embargo list.

alex: Who signs off on the hero image? Design?

nina: Design already uploaded a hero. @deploy-bot can you attach the hero URL to the town slide deck?

deploy-bot: Attached asset "launch-hero-v3.png" to deck "Exec Town - May".

press-bot: Press kit updated: added privacy blurb and bench one-pager v3. Link: https://press.redwood.ai/kit-v3

sophie: Timing: We'll embargo until 09:00 PT release day. PR to send embargo list 24h prior. Also coordinating with partner announcement at 09:05 PT; we need a short joint quote.

cameron: Partner quote draft: "Partnering with Acme Cloud to deliver predictable inference at scale." Need partner legal to sign off.

legal: Iterate: "In partnership with Acme Cloud, Redwood Inference offers predictable inference throughput for production workloads." Partner legal must approve.

nina: Final checklist for town mention: slide + CEO 1-liner + 1-sentence partner line + link to press kit. Drop items by 4pm PT and i'll assemble.

sophie: Dropping the CEO final one-liner now: "Were excited to make production-grade LLM inference accessible to every engineering team."

alex: I'll build the slide and ping design for final alignment.

nina: Thanks team. After town we'll schedule a short post with exec quote + link to blog. :sparkles:
